title: Mind Palace
summary: AI-powered learning platform that transforms PDFs into interactive study notebooks with AI summaries, topic-aware flashcards, quizzes, study plans, mnemonics, and RAG-style Socratic tutoring.
highlights: PDF to notebook pipeline storing extracted text, summaries, and topics in MongoDB.
Local int8 ONNX embeddings (nomic-embed-text-v1.5) for topic-aware text slicing.
Integrated Socratic tutor ('Talk to Doc') utilizing RAG-style topic context.
Gamified learning with task scheduling, quiz scoring, and achievement tracking.
